notes.title: 🌙 Lunhowl v0.1.5 Update Howls Live! 🐺✨
notes.content: [p]Hello, [i]Lunhowl[/i] adventurers! The v0.1.5 update is here, bringing fresh polish to your journey. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]Upgraded Visuals[/b]: Scenes now pop with updated materials and enhanced lighting for a more immersive experience. 🌌[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lively Mascots[/b]: New animations make our mascots more vibrant, adding extra charm to your gameplay! 🐾[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level Select Scene[/b]: A sleek new level selection scene has been added to streamline your adventure. 🎮[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother Gameplay[/b]: General bugs have been fixed to ensure a cleaner, more enjoyable experience. 🛠️[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re excited to showcase [i]Lunhowl[/i] at [b]Next Fest[/b]! 🎉 Dive into the updated version, explore the changes, and share your feedback as we continue crafting this world. Stay wild! 🌕 #LunhowlNextFest[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589426/a1f7b78dc04268186a1fc9ba05e326fbff5dfcd9.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Minor Patch & Bug Fix Update 🛠️
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Players! We’ve rolled out a small update to address various bugs and introduce some new features. Here’s what’s changed in this patch:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sound Bug Fix 🔊:[/b] The mute/unmute button now functions correctly, so toggling sound on and off works as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Environments 🌲:[/b] Several new environments have been added to the scene, offering fresh areas to explore and haunting visuals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting Adjustments 💡:[/b] Scene lighting has been tweaked to improve atmosphere and better highlight environmental details.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Launch-Screen Trailer 🎬:[/b] A short trailer has been integrated into the game’s opening screen to set the mood before you dive in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]General Bug Fixes 🐛:[/b] We’ve squashed various minor bugs and stability issues to ensure a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upon-Death Ghost Mode Improvements 👻:[/b] When a player dies, they now transform into a ghost seamlessly—enjoy unlimited stamina and the ability to unlock doors in ghost form so you won’t run out of breath or get stuck behind locked doors.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing, and we hope you enjoy these refinements. As always, please continue to share your feedback so we can keep improving the experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589426/e00ac44c36cee8adb45f5434eb4f730de461f6e3.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Small Update – Bug Fixes, Balancing & New UI
notes.content:
📄 Event Description:
This update includes various improvements and changes:

⚖️ Energy and creature balancing for smoother gameplay.

🧭 New UI designs for menu transitions and overall navigation.

🎬 A tutorial video with subtitles has been added to the main menu to help new players understand the game.

🔊 Sound controls (volume up/down) have been added to the settings menu.

🎒 New items have been added. These will be used mainly for achievements in the future (note: achievements are not active yet in the demo).

🛠️ General bug fixes for a more stable experience.

🚪 Added an option to exit to the main menu from inside the game.

Thanks for your support and feedback!
